```python
# --- KafkaSink -----------------------------------------------------------------------------


class FakeProducer:
    def __init__(self, full: int = 0):
        self.full = full
        self.produced: list[tuple[str, bytes, bytes, object]] = []
        self.polls: list[float] = []

    def produce(self, topic, value, key, headers, on_delivery):
        if self.full:
            self.full -= 1
            raise BufferError("Local: Queue full")
        self.produced.append((topic, key, value, headers))

    def poll(self, timeout):
        self.polls.append(timeout)
        return 0

    def flush(self, timeout):
        return 3


class FakeRecord:
    def topic(self):
        return "queue.v1"


def test_kafka_sink_sends_header_and_retries_full_local_queue():
    producer = FakeProducer(full=2)
    sink = dmain.KafkaSink(producer)
    sink.send("queue.v1", b"S1", b"{}", 42)
    assert producer.produced == [("queue.v1", b"S1", b"{}", [("vq-src-offset", b"42")])]
    assert producer.polls == [0.1, 0.1, 0]
    assert sink.flush(10.0) == 3


def test_kafka_sink_keeps_first_delivery_error():
    sink = dmain.KafkaSink(FakeProducer())
    sink.on_delivery(None, FakeRecord())
    assert sink.failed is None
    sink.on_delivery(KafkaError(KafkaError._MSG_TIMED_OUT), FakeRecord())
    sink.on_delivery(KafkaError(KafkaError._TRANSPORT), FakeRecord())
    assert sink.failed == "queue.v1: Local: Message timed out"

def test_kafka_error_callback_logs_and_raises_only_on_fatal(caplog):
    """error_cb: нефатальная ошибка — WARNING и работа дальше; фатальная (producer) — KafkaFatal, то есть выход 1."""
    p, *_ = make()
    p.on_assign(40, 50)
    fatal = KafkaError(KafkaError.OUT_OF_ORDER_SEQUENCE_NUMBER, "Broker: Out of order sequence number", fatal=True)
    with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger="vq.dispatcher"):
        dmain.on_kafka_error(KafkaError(KafkaError._TRANSPORT, "Disconnected"), p)
        with pytest.raises(dmain.KafkaFatal, match="Out of order sequence number"):
            dmain.on_kafka_error(fatal, p)
    got = [(r.levelname, r.fields["code"], r.fields["fatal"], r.fields["epoch"]) for r in caplog.records]
    assert got == [("WARNING", "_TRANSPORT", False, 7), ("ERROR", "OUT_OF_ORDER_SEQUENCE_NUMBER", True, 7)]

        "logger": "vq.kafka",
        "event": "log",
        "site": "site-1",
        "epoch": None,
        "offset": None,
        "msg": "FAIL|rdkafka#consumer-1| boom",

# --- main.run и consume_loop с поддельными Kafka и Postgres: связка, коды выхода, строки выхода -------------


class FakeConsumer:
    """confluent_kafka.Consumer в миниатюре: consume() проигрывает сценарий шагов.

    Шаг ("assign" | "revoke" | "lost", [партиции]) вызывает колбэк группы изнутри consume(), как librdkafka;
    ("msgs", [Message]) — ответ consume(). Сценарий кончился — выставляется stop (как по SIGTERM).
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        script: list[tuple],
        stop: threading.Event,
        partitions: int,
        watermarks: tuple[int, int],
        close_error: Exception | None = None,
    ):
        self.script = list(script)
        self.stop = stop
        self.partitions = partitions
        self.watermarks = watermarks
        self.close_error = close_error
        self.conf: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.callbacks: dict[str, Callable[..., None]] = {}
        self.calls: list[tuple] = []

    def __call__(self, conf: dict[str, Any]) -> "FakeConsumer":  # вместо конструктора confluent_kafka.Consumer
        self.conf = conf
        return self

    def list_topics(self, topic: str, timeout: float) -> SimpleNamespace:
        parts = dict.fromkeys(range(self.partitions))
        return SimpleNamespace(topics={topic: SimpleNamespace(error=None, partitions=parts)})

    def subscribe(self, topics: list[str], on_assign, on_revoke, on_lost) -> None:
        self.calls.append(("subscribe", topics))
        self.callbacks = {"assign": on_assign, "revoke": on_revoke, "lost": on_lost}

    def get_watermark_offsets(self, tp: TopicPartition, timeout: float | None = None, cached: bool = False):
        return self.watermarks

    def assign(self, partitions: list[TopicPartition]) -> None:
        self.calls.append(("assign", [(tp.topic, tp.partition, tp.offset) for tp in partitions]))

    def seek(self, tp: TopicPartition) -> None:
        self.calls.append(("seek", tp.offset))

    def commit(self, offsets: list[TopicPartition], asynchronous: bool) -> None:
        self.calls.append(("commit", [tp.offset for tp in offsets], asynchronous))

    def close(self) -> None:
        self.calls.append(("close",))
        if self.close_error is not None:
            raise self.close_error

    def consume(self, num_messages: int, timeout: float) -> list[Message]:
        assert (num_messages, timeout) == (500, 0.25)
        if not self.script:
            self.stop.set()
            return []
        kind, *args = self.script.pop(0)
        if kind in self.callbacks:
            self.callbacks[kind](self, args[0] if args else [TopicPartition("telemetry.v1", 0)])
            return []
        assert kind == "msgs", kind
        return args[0]

    def made(self, *kinds: str) -> list[tuple]:
        return [c for c in self.calls if c[0] in kinds]


class FakeKafkaProducer:
    """confluent_kafka.Producer: запоминает записи; fatal — ошибка, которую librdkafka отдаст в error_cb из flush."""

    def __init__(self, remaining: int, fatal: KafkaError | None):
        self.conf: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.produced: list[tuple] = []
        self.remaining = remaining
        self.fatal = fatal

    def __call__(self, conf: dict[str, Any]) -> "FakeKafkaProducer":
        self.conf = conf
        return self

    def produce(self, topic, value, key, headers, on_delivery) -> None:
        self.produced.append((topic, key, value, headers))

    def poll(self, timeout: float) -> int:
        return 0

    def flush(self, timeout: float) -> int:
        if self.fatal is not None:
            self.conf["error_cb"](self.fatal)
        return self.remaining


class FakePgStore(FakeStore):
    """PgStore: error — из checkpoint, migrate_stuck — migrate висит до события, *_error — исключения migrate, close."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        claim: Claim,
        accept: bool,
        error: Exception | None,
        migrate_error: Exception | None = None,
        migrate_stuck: threading.Event | None = None,
        close_error: Exception | None = None,
    ):
        super().__init__([], claim, accept)
        self.error = error
        self.migrate_error = migrate_error
        self.migrate_stuck = migrate_stuck
        self.close_error = close_error
        self.migrated = False
        self.closed = False

    def migrate(self) -> None:
        self.migrated = True
        if self.migrate_stuck is not None:
            assert self.migrate_stuck.wait(5)
        if self.migrate_error is not None:
            raise self.migrate_error

    def checkpoint(self, site_id: str, epoch: int, next_offset: int, counters: Counters, state: SiteState) -> bool:
        if self.error is not None:
            raise self.error
        return super().checkpoint(site_id, epoch, next_offset, counters, state)

    def close(self) -> None:
        self.closed = True
        if self.close_error is not None:
            raise self.close_error


class LogLines(logging.Handler):
    """Строки лога в JSON в момент записи, как в stdout: defaults форматтера run() меняет по ходу старта."""

    def __init__(self, formatter: logging.Formatter) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.setFormatter(formatter)
        self.lines: list[dict] = []

    def emit(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> None:
        self.lines.append(json.loads(self.format(record)))


@dataclass
class Ran:
    code: int
    consumer: FakeConsumer
    store: FakePgStore
    producer: FakeKafkaProducer
    registry: CollectorRegistry
    lines: list[dict]  # строки лога vq.dispatcher в JSON, как их пишет JsonFormatter
    opened: list[tuple[str, Path]]  # попытки подключиться к Postgres: (dsn, каталог миграций)

    def events(self) -> list[str]:
        return [d["event"] for d in self.lines]

    def line(self, event: str) -> dict:
        (found,) = [d for d in self.lines if d["event"] == event]
        return found


@pytest.fixture
def run_dispatcher(monkeypatch, caplog) -> Callable[..., Ran]:
    def go(
        script: list[tuple],
        *,
        claim: Claim | None = None,
        accept: bool = True,
        store_error: Exception | None = None,
        remaining: int = 0,
        producer_fatal: KafkaError | None = None,
        partitions: int = 1,
        watermarks: tuple[int, int] = (0, 100),
        env: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        pg_down: int = 0,
        pg_wait_s: float = 60.0,
        sigterm_after: int | None = None,
        migrate_error: Exception | None = None,
        migrate_stuck: threading.Event | None = None,
        deadline: Deadline | None = None,
        consumer_close_error: Exception | None = None,
        store_close_error: Exception | None = None,
        config_error: Exception | None = None,
    ) -> Ran:
        """pg_down — столько первых подключений к Postgres падают; sigterm_after — SIGTERM на этой попытке;
        config_error — исключение чтения site.toml."""
        cfg = two_stations()
        stop = threading.Event()
        consumer = FakeConsumer(script, stop, partitions, watermarks, consumer_close_error)
        store = FakePgStore(
            claim or empty_claim(), accept, store_error, migrate_error, migrate_stuck, store_close_error
        )
        producer = FakeKafkaProducer(remaining, producer_fatal)
        reg = CollectorRegistry()
        opened: list[tuple[str, Path]] = []

        def open_pg(dsn: str, migrations_dir: Path) -> FakePgStore:
            opened.append((dsn, migrations_dir))
            if len(opened) == sigterm_after:
                stop.set()
            if len(opened) <= pg_down:
                raise psycopg.OperationalError(f"connection to server failed: Connection refused ({len(opened)})")
            return store

        def load_config(path: str) -> SiteConfig:
            if config_error is not None:
                raise config_error
            return cfg

        monkeypatch.setattr(dmain, "load_config", load_config)
        monkeypatch.setattr(dmain, "config_hash", lambda path: "cfg-hash")
        monkeypatch.setattr(dmain, "PgStore", open_pg)
        monkeypatch.setattr(dmain, "PG_RETRY_S", 0.0)
        monkeypatch.setattr(dmain, "PG_WAIT_S", pg_wait_s)
        if deadline is not None:
            monkeypatch.setattr(dmain, "Deadline", lambda: deadline)
        monkeypatch.setattr(dmain, "Producer", producer)
        monkeypatch.setattr(dmain, "Consumer", consumer)
        monkeypatch.setattr(dmain, "DispatcherMetrics", lambda stations: DispatcherMetrics(reg, stations=stations))
        monkeypatch.setattr(dmain, "start_http_server", lambda port: None)
        fmt = JsonFormatter()
        out = LogLines(fmt)
        dlog = logging.getLogger("vq.dispatcher")
        dlog.addHandler(out)
        try:
            with caplog.at_level(logging.INFO, logger="vq.dispatcher"):
                code = dmain.run(env or {}, fmt, stop)
        finally:
            dlog.removeHandler(out)
        return Ran(code, consumer, store, producer, reg, out.lines, opened)

    return go


def kafka_msgs(raws: list[bytes | None], start: int) -> list[Message]:
    return [Message(topic="telemetry.v1", partition=0, offset=start + i, value=r) for i, r in enumerate(raws)]


def kafka_error(code: int, reason: str = "") -> Message:
    return Message(topic="telemetry.v1", partition=0, error=KafkaError(code, reason or None))


def test_run_assigns_explicit_offset_commits_reports_lag_and_closes_on_stop(run_dispatcher):
    cfg = two_stations()
    raws = example(cfg)
    r = run_dispatcher([("assign",), ("msgs", kafka_msgs(raws, 40))], watermarks=(40, 52))
    assert r.code == dmain.EXIT_OK
    assert r.consumer.conf["group.instance.id"] == "dispatcher-test" and r.store.migrated
    assert r.consumer.calls[0] == ("subscribe", ["telemetry.v1"])
    # assign с явным offset из claim (а не из committed), commit асинхронно на конец пачки, затем close
    assert r.consumer.made("assign", "seek", "commit", "close") == [
        ("assign", [("telemetry.v1", 0, 40)]),
        ("commit", [45], True),
        ("close",),
    ]
    assert r.registry.get_sample_value("vq_consumer_lag_messages") == 52 - 45
    sent = [(t, k, v, src_headers(s)) for t, k, v, s in offline(cfg, raws, 40)]
    assert r.producer.produced == sent
    assert r.store.checkpoints[-1][1] == 45 and r.store.closed
    assert r.events() == ["start", "claim", "decision", "decision", "stop"]
    assert (r.line("claim")["epoch"], r.line("claim")["offset"], r.line("stop")["offset"]) == (7, 40, 45)
    assert all(list(d)[:7] == ["ts", "level", "logger", "event", "site", "epoch", "offset"] for d in r.lines)


def test_run_seeks_back_to_expected_offset_after_dropped_batch(run_dispatcher):
    cfg = two_stations()
    raws = example(cfg)
    claim = Claim(3, 5, None, Counters(), SiteState())
    r = run_dispatcher(
        [("assign",), ("msgs", kafka_msgs(raws, 2)), ("msgs", kafka_msgs(raws, 5))], claim=claim, watermarks=(0, 10)
    )
    assert r.code == dmain.EXIT_OK
    assert r.consumer.made("assign", "seek", "commit") == [
        ("assign", [("telemetry.v1", 0, 5)]),
        ("seek", 5),
        ("commit", [10], True),
    ]
    assert r.line("batch_dropped")["got"] == 2 and r.store.checkpoints[-1][1] == 10


def test_run_ignores_empty_assignment_and_drops_engine_on_lost_partition(run_dispatcher):
    cfg = two_stations()
    r = run_dispatcher([("assign", []), ("assign",), ("lost", []), ("msgs", kafka_msgs(example(cfg), 0))])
    assert r.code == dmain.EXIT_OK
    assert len(r.store.claims) == 1  # пустое назначение (участников больше, чем партиций) — без claim и assign
    assert r.consumer.made("assign") == [("assign", [("telemetry.v1", 0, 0)])]
    assert r.producer.produced == [] and r.store.checkpoints == [] and r.consumer.made("commit") == []
    assert r.line("lost")["epoch"] == 7


def test_run_logs_informational_consume_errors_and_keeps_going(run_dispatcher):
    cfg = two_stations()
    transport = kafka_error(KafkaError._TRANSPORT, "Disconnected")
    r = run_dispatcher([("assign",), ("msgs", [transport, *kafka_msgs(example(cfg), 0)])], watermarks=(0, 5))
    assert r.code == dmain.EXIT_OK
    err = r.line("kafka_error")
    assert (err["level"], err["code"], err["epoch"], err["offset"]) == ("INFO", "_TRANSPORT", 7, 0)
    assert r.store.checkpoints[-1][1] == 5


def _kernel_boom(self: Engine, raw: bytes | None) -> Any:
    raise RuntimeError("ядро упало")


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("case", "event"),
    [
        ("fenced", "exit_fenced"),
        ("delivery", "exit_delivery_failed"),
        ("postgres", "exit_postgres"),
        ("kernel", "exit_crash"),
        ("consumer_fatal", "exit_kafka_fatal"),
        ("producer_fatal", "exit_kafka_fatal"),
    ],
)
def test_run_failure_exits_1_and_exit_line_names_epoch_and_batch(run_dispatcher, monkeypatch, case, event):
    """Crash-only (§2.4): выход 1, consumer закрыт, строка выхода несёт site, epoch и offset упавшей пачки."""
    msgs = kafka_msgs(example(two_stations()), 40)
    kw: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if case == "fenced":
        kw["accept"] = False
    elif case == "delivery":
        kw["remaining"] = 2
    elif case == "postgres":
        kw["store_error"] = psycopg.errors.QueryCanceled("canceling statement due to statement timeout")
    elif case == "kernel":
        monkeypatch.setattr(Engine, "apply", _kernel_boom)
    elif case == "consumer_fatal":  # вытеснение по group.instance.id: код _FATAL, fatal() == False
        msgs = [kafka_error(KafkaError._FATAL, "Fatal error: Broker: Static consumer fenced by other consumer")]
    elif case == "producer_fatal":
        kw["producer_fatal"] = KafkaError(KafkaError.OUT_OF_ORDER_SEQUENCE_NUMBER, "Broker: Out of order", fatal=True)
    r = run_dispatcher([("assign",), ("msgs", msgs), ("msgs", kafka_msgs([None], 45))], watermarks=(40, 60), **kw)
    assert r.code == dmain.EXIT_FAILURE
    last = {k: r.lines[-1][k] for k in ("event", "level", "site", "epoch", "offset")}
    assert last == {"event": event, "level": "ERROR", "site": "test", "epoch": 7, "offset": 40}
    assert r.consumer.made("close") == [("close",)] and r.store.closed
    assert r.consumer.made("commit") == []  # следующая пачка не обрабатывалась


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("kw", "tail", "reason"),
    [
        ({"partitions": 2}, [], "partitions"),
        ({"claim": Claim(2, 500, NOON, Counters(), SiteState(now=NOON))}, [], "log_recreated"),
        ({}, [("msgs", [kafka_error(KafkaError._AUTO_OFFSET_RESET, "offset out of range")])], "state_older_than_log"),
    ],
)
def test_run_refusal_exits_2_with_reason_and_hint(run_dispatcher, kw, tail, reason):
    r = run_dispatcher([("assign",), *tail], **kw)
    assert r.code == dmain.EXIT_REFUSED
    last = r.lines[-1]
    assert (last["event"], last["reason"], last["hint"]) == ("start_refused", reason, "make reset")
    assert r.consumer.made("close") == [("close",)] and r.store.closed and r.store.checkpoints == []


# --- старт: ожидание Postgres, сторож миграции, схема, закрытие -----------------------------------------


def test_run_waits_for_postgres_then_starts(run_dispatcher):
    """Старт при недоступном Postgres ждёт его в процессе (§2.6): без ожидания каждый старт выходил бы за доли
    секунды, Docker удваивал бы паузу перед рестартом (до 60 с), и после возврата Postgres площадка ждала бы
    очередного рестарта. Попытка — раз в PG_RETRY_S, строка waiting_for_postgres на каждую неудачу."""
    cfg = two_stations()
    r = run_dispatcher([("assign",), ("msgs", kafka_msgs(example(cfg), 0))], pg_down=3, watermarks=(0, 5))
    assert r.code == dmain.EXIT_OK and len(r.opened) == 4
    waits = [d for d in r.lines if d["event"] == "waiting_for_postgres"]
    assert [(d["level"], d["attempt"]) for d in waits] == [("WARNING", 1), ("WARNING", 2), ("WARNING", 3)]
    assert waits[0]["error"] == "OperationalError: connection to server failed: Connection refused (1)"
    assert r.events()[3:5] == ["start", "claim"] and r.store.checkpoints[-1][1] == 5


def test_run_gives_up_waiting_for_postgres_and_exits_1(run_dispatcher):
    r = run_dispatcher([("assign",)], pg_down=10**6, pg_wait_s=0.0)
    assert r.code == dmain.EXIT_FAILURE and len(r.opened) == 1
    assert r.events() == ["exit_postgres"] and r.lines[-1]["error"].startswith("OperationalError: ")
    assert r.consumer.conf == {} and not r.store.migrated  # дальше подключения старт не пошёл


def test_sigterm_while_waiting_for_postgres_exits_0(run_dispatcher):
    r = run_dispatcher([("assign",)], pg_down=10**6, sigterm_after=2)
    assert r.code == dmain.EXIT_OK and len(r.opened) == 2
    assert r.events() == ["waiting_for_postgres", "waiting_for_postgres"] and r.consumer.conf == {}


def test_stalled_migrate_exits_1(run_dispatcher):
    """Сторож и на миграции: advisory lock и DDL на замёрзшем Postgres висели бы до разморозки."""
    release = threading.Event()
    exits: list[int] = []

    def fake_exit(code: int) -> None:
        exits.append(code)
        release.set()  # в проде процесса уже нет

    r = run_dispatcher([], migrate_stuck=release, deadline=Deadline(0.05, exit_fn=fake_exit))
    assert exits == [dmain.EXIT_FAILURE]
    line = r.line("exit_postgres_stalled")
    assert (line["op"], line["level"], line["site"], line["deadline_s"]) == ("migrate", "ERROR", "test", 0.05)


def test_schema_mismatch_refuses_start_with_exit_2(run_dispatcher):
    """Схема в Postgres не та, что в коде (том до колонки radius_station): отказ с подсказкой make reset,
    а не UndefinedColumn на claim и выход 1 в цикле рестартов."""
    refused = StartRefused("schema_changed", "vehicles: нет колонок radius_station")
    r = run_dispatcher([("assign",)], migrate_error=refused)
    assert r.code == dmain.EXIT_REFUSED
    last = r.lines[-1]
    assert (last["event"], last["reason"], last["hint"]) == ("start_refused", "schema_changed", "make reset")
    assert r.store.closed and r.consumer.conf == {}


def test_close_failures_are_logged_with_the_error(run_dispatcher):
    r = run_dispatcher(
        [("assign",)],
        partitions=2,
        consumer_close_error=KafkaException(KafkaError(KafkaError._TRANSPORT, "Disconnected")),
        store_close_error=psycopg.OperationalError("server closed the connection unexpectedly"),
    )
    assert r.code == dmain.EXIT_REFUSED
    consumer, store = r.line("consumer_close_failed"), r.line("store_close_failed")
    assert consumer["level"] == store["level"] == "WARNING"
    assert consumer["error"].startswith("KafkaException: ") and "Disconnected" in consumer["error"]
    assert store["error"] == "OperationalError: server closed the connection unexpectedly"


def test_exit_before_the_config_is_read_still_has_site_epoch_offset(run_dispatcher):
    """§2.4: site, epoch и offset — в каждой строке; пока site.toml не прочитан, они null, исключение — в error."""
    r = run_dispatcher([], config_error=ConfigError("assignment: машина T9 без станции"))
    assert r.code == dmain.EXIT_FAILURE and r.events() == ["exit_crash"] and r.opened == []
    line = r.line("exit_crash")
    assert (line["level"], line["site"], line["epoch"], line["offset"]) == ("ERROR", None, None, None)
    assert line["error"].endswith("ConfigError: assignment: машина T9 без станции")


def test_migrations_dir_comes_from_env(run_dispatcher):
    """Путь к SQL — из VQ_MIGRATIONS (в compose /app/migrations); без неё — каталог дерева исходников."""
    r = run_dispatcher([], env={"VQ_MIGRATIONS": "/app/migrations", "VQ_PG_DSN": "postgresql://h/vq"})
    assert r.opened == [("postgresql://h/vq", Path("/app/migrations"))]
    assert run_dispatcher([]).opened == [(dmain.DEFAULT_PG_DSN, MIGRATIONS_DIR)]


def test_sigterm_sets_stop_and_main_exits_with_run_code(monkeypatch):
    """SIGTERM только выставляет stop: цикл доделывает пачку, run закрывает consumer и возвращает 0 (см. тесты run)."""
    seen: dict[str, object] = {}

    installed = JsonFormatter()

    def fake_run(env, formatter, stop: threading.Event) -> int:
        seen["formatter"] = formatter
        os.kill(os.getpid(), signal.SIGTERM)
        seen["stopped"] = stop.wait(5)
        return dmain.EXIT_OK

    monkeypatch.setattr(dmain, "run", fake_run)
    monkeypatch.setattr(dmain, "setup_logging", lambda: installed)  # корневой логгер pytest не трогаем
    monkeypatch.setattr(dmain.logging, "shutdown", lambda: None)
    saved = {s: signal.getsignal(s) for s in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT)}
    try:
        with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as exited:
            dmain.main()
    finally:
        for s, handler in saved.items():
            signal.signal(s, handler)
    assert seen["stopped"] is True and exited.value.code == dmain.EXIT_OK
    assert seen["formatter"] is installed  # run() задаёт defaults форматтеру, который пишет в stdout
```

Интеграционные тесты `PgStore` задачи 6 на настоящем Postgres (§6.2, маркер `integration`, testcontainers с образом `postgres:18.4-trixie`): миграция и колонки §2.5, сверка схемы (`schema_changed`), таймауты сессии и TCP §2.4, `claim` и `epoch`, фенсинг, побитовое состояние, рестарт без потерь и повторов, отказы по версиям и чужому состоянию. Последний тест замораживает контейнер (`docker pause`) и проверяет, что процесс с настоящим store выходит с кодом 1 за срок сторожа со строкой `exit_postgres_stalled`; дочерний процесс пишет её через `vq.logs`. `make test` (`-m "not integration"`) этот файл не запускает.

Create `tests/test_store_pg.py`:
```python
"""PgStore на настоящем Postgres (§6.2): epoch, фенсинг, побитовое состояние, рестарт без потерь и повторов,
сторож вызовов на замёрзшем сервере."""

import copy
import json
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from collections.abc import Iterator
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import psycopg
import pytest

from tests.dispatcher_helpers import line_site, scenario
from vq.core.engine import LOGIC_VERSION, Engine
from vq.core.model import SERVED, SERVICE, TO_DUMP, TO_STATION, WAITING, SiteState, Station, Vehicle
from vq.dispatcher.store import Counters, PgStore, StartRefused, checkpoint_params

pytestmark = pytest.mark.integration

IMAGE = "postgres:18.4-trixie"
SITE = "site-1"
HASH = "h" * 64
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def pg() -> Iterator[Any]:
    from testcontainers.community.postgres import PostgresContainer

    with PostgresContainer(IMAGE, driver=None) as container:
        yield container


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def dsn(pg: Any) -> str:
    return pg.get_connection_url()


@pytest.fixture
def admin(dsn: str) -> Iterator[psycopg.Connection]:
    """Отдельное соединение: видит только зафиксированное. Каждый тест — с чистой схемы."""
    with psycopg.connect(dsn, autocommit=True) as conn:
        conn.execute("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS processor, stations, vehicles")
        yield conn


@pytest.fixture
def store(dsn: str, admin: psycopg.Connection) -> Iterator[PgStore]:
    s = PgStore(dsn)
    s.migrate()
    yield s
    s.close()


def tables(admin: psycopg.Connection) -> dict[str, list[tuple]]:
    """Полный снимок таблиц, включая updated_at: «ничего не изменилось» проверяется буквально."""
    return {t: admin.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {t} ORDER BY 1").fetchall() for t in ("processor", "stations", "vehicles")}


def tricky_state() -> SiteState:
    """Значения на границах точности и NULL: float с хвостом, денормализованные, −0.0, NULL против '[]'."""
    vehicles = {
        "T-02": Vehicle(
            "T-02",
            "S1",
            4_102_444_799,
            0.1 + 0.2,
            1e-300,
            49.12880000000001,
            WAITING,
            "S2",
            radius_station="S2",
            radius_entered_at=1_789_473_600,
            arrived_at=1_789_473_601,
            dump_visited=False,
            decided=True,
            predicted_start=1_789_473_830,
        ),
        "T-01": Vehicle("T-01", "S1", 1_000_000_000, -0.0, 5e-324, 0.0, TO_DUMP, "S1", dump_visited=True),
        "Т-кир": Vehicle(
            "Т-кир",
            "S2",
            1_789_473_599,
            89.99999999999999,
            -179.99999999999997,
            299.99999999999994,
            SERVICE,
            "S2",
            radius_station='Ст-кир "q" ✓',
            radius_entered_at=1,
            arrived_at=2,
            decided=True,
        ),
        "T-04": Vehicle("T-04", "S2", 1_789_473_000, 49.1288, 142.66010000000003, 36.0, SERVED, "S2"),
        "T-03": Vehicle("T-03", "S1", 1_789_473_001, -49.1288, -142.6601, 0.5, TO_STATION, "S1", predicted_start=-5),
        "T-05": Vehicle(  # в радиусе нецелевой станции: вход запомнен, цель другая
            "T-05", "S1", 1_789_473_002, 49.2, 142.7, 36.0, TO_STATION, "S2", radius_station="S1", radius_entered_at=7
        ),
    }
    stations = {
        "S2": Station("S2", "Т-кир", 1_789_473_500, 1_789_473_400, "[]"),
        "S1": Station("S1", None, None, None, None),
        "S3": Station(
            "S3",
            None,
            None,
            1_789_473_000,
            '[{"unit_uuid":"Т-кир \\"q\\" \\\\ ✓","eta":null,"service_start":"2026-09-15T11:59:00Z"}]',
        ),
    }
    return SiteState(now=4_102_444_799, vehicles=vehicles, stations=stations)


def float_bits(state: SiteState) -> dict[str, tuple[str, str, str]]:
    return {u: (v.lat.hex(), v.lon.hex(), v.speed_kmh.hex()) for u, v in state.vehicles.items()}


# --- миграция и claim ---------------------------------------------------------------


def test_migrate_is_idempotent_and_creates_spec_columns(store, admin):
    store.migrate()
    cols = admin.execute(
        "SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns "
        "WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position"
    ).fetchall()
    assert ("vehicles", "lat", "double precision", "NO") in cols
    assert ("vehicles", "radius_station", "text", "YES") in cols
    assert ("vehicles", "predicted_start", "bigint", "YES") in cols
    assert ("stations", "last_published_queue", "text", "YES") in cols
    assert ("processor", "next_offset", "bigint", "YES") in cols
    assert len(cols) == 10 + 6 + 15
    vehicle_cols = [c[1] for c in cols if c[0] == "vehicles"]
    assert vehicle_cols[vehicle_cols.index("radius_station") + 1] == "radius_entered_at"


def test_session_has_spec_timeouts_keepalives_and_autocommit(store):
    """§2.4: таймауты сессии и TCP keepalive действительно применены к соединению PgStore.

    keepalives_interval/count и tcp_user_timeout — клиентские сроки на обрыв сети: без них запрос в оборванное
    соединение ждёт TCP-ретраев около 15 минут, а мёртвое простаивающее соединение находится через ~11 минут.
    """
    conn = store._conn
    names = ("statement_timeout", "lock_timeout", "idle_in_transaction_session_timeout")
    shown = {name: conn.execute(f"SHOW {name}").fetchone()[0] for name in names}
    assert shown == {"statement_timeout": "5s", "lock_timeout": "2s", "idle_in_transaction_session_timeout": "10s"}
    params = conn.info.get_parameters()
    keys = ("connect_timeout", "keepalives", "keepalives_idle", "keepalives_interval", "keepalives_count")
    assert {k: params.get(k) for k in (*keys, "tcp_user_timeout")} == {
        "connect_timeout": "5",
        "keepalives": "1",
        "keepalives_idle": "5",
        "keepalives_interval": "2",
        "keepalives_count": "3",
        "tcp_user_timeout": "10000",
    }
    assert conn.autocommit  # чекпоинт — одна инструкция за один round-trip


def test_claim_creates_row_and_increments_epoch(store, admin):
    first = store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
    assert (first.epoch, first.next_offset, first.now_ts, first.state) == (1, None, None, None)
    assert first.counters == Counters()
    second = store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
    assert second.epoch == 2
    assert admin.execute("SELECT epoch, next_offset FROM processor WHERE site_id = %s", (SITE,)).fetchone() == (2, None)


def test_stale_schema_refuses_start_and_rolls_back(dsn, store, admin):
    """Том со схемой другой версии кода (до колонки radius_station): CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS её не добавит.

    Без проверки claim падал бы на UndefinedColumn (выход 1 и цикл рестартов), а при пустом состоянии — первый
    чекпоинт. Отказ schema_changed с подсказкой make reset называет и недостающие, и лишние колонки.
    """
    claim = store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
    assert store.checkpoint(SITE, claim.epoch, 5, Counters(5, 0, 0), tricky_state())
    admin.execute("ALTER TABLE vehicles DROP COLUMN radius_station")
    admin.execute("ALTER TABLE stations ADD COLUMN legacy text")
    before = tables(admin)
    restarted = PgStore(dsn)
    try:
        with pytest.raises(StartRefused) as refused:
            restarted.migrate()
    finally:
        restarted.close()
    assert refused.value.reason == "schema_changed" and refused.value.hint == "make reset"
    assert refused.value.detail == "stations: лишние колонки legacy; vehicles: нет колонок radius_station"
    assert tables(admin) == before


# --- фенсинг ------------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_checkpoint_with_old_epoch_is_rejected_and_changes_nothing(dsn, store, admin):
    cfg = line_site()
    stream = scenario(cfg, horizon=120)
    zombie = Engine(cfg)
    for r in stream[:300]:
        zombie.apply(r)
    old = store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
    assert store.checkpoint(SITE, old.epoch, 300, Counters(300, 0, 0), zombie.state)
    other = PgStore(dsn)  # второй экземпляр забирает площадку
    try:
        new = other.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
        assert new.epoch == old.epoch + 1 and new.next_offset == 300
        before = tables(admin)
        for r in stream[300:600]:  # зомби продолжает и пытается записать
            zombie.apply(r)
        assert not store.checkpoint(SITE, old.epoch, 600, Counters(600, 0, 0), zombie.state)
        assert tables(admin) == before
        assert other.checkpoint(SITE, new.epoch, 600, Counters(600, 0, 0), zombie.state)
        assert tables(admin) != before
    finally:
        other.close()


# --- побитовое состояние ---------------------------------------------------------------


def test_state_round_trips_bit_exact(store, admin):
    state = tricky_state()
    claim = store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
    assert store.checkpoint(SITE, claim.epoch, 123, Counters(5, 6, 7), state)
    got = store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
    assert (got.next_offset, got.now_ts, got.counters) == (123, 4_102_444_799, Counters(5, 6, 7))
    assert got.state == state
    assert float_bits(got.state) == float_bits(state)
    assert got.state.vehicles["T-01"].lat.hex() == "-0x0.0p+0"
    assert [(u, v.radius_station) for u, v in got.state.vehicles.items()] == [
        ("T-01", None),
        ("T-02", "S2"),
        ("T-03", None),
        ("T-04", None),
        ("T-05", "S1"),
        ("Т-кир", 'Ст-кир "q" ✓'),
    ]
    assert admin.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM vehicles WHERE radius_station IS NULL").fetchone() == (3,)
    assert got.state.stations["S1"].last_published_queue is None
    assert got.state.stations["S2"].last_published_queue == "[]"
    assert list(got.state.vehicles) == sorted(state.vehicles)  # ORDER BY ключу
    assert list(got.state.stations) == ["S1", "S2", "S3"]
    assert admin.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM stations WHERE last_published_queue IS NULL").fetchone() == (1,)


def test_row_order_and_repeated_upserts_do_not_matter(store):
    state = tricky_state()
    claim = store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
    rng = random.Random(7)
    for i in range(5):  # тот же набор строк в разном порядке словарей, с изменениями между чекпоинтами
        units = list(state.vehicles)
        rng.shuffle(units)
        state = SiteState(state.now, {u: state.vehicles[u] for u in units}, dict(reversed(state.stations.items())))
        state.vehicles["T-04"].last_ts += 1
        state.stations["S1"].last_published_queue = None if i % 2 else "[]"
        assert store.checkpoint(SITE, claim.epoch, 10 + i, Counters(i, 0, 0), state)
    got = store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH).state
    assert got == state and float_bits(got) == float_bits(state)


def test_empty_state_with_null_now_round_trips(store):
    state = Engine(line_site()).state  # только станции: после пачки невалидных сообщений
    claim = store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
    assert store.checkpoint(SITE, claim.epoch, 3, Counters(0, 0, 3), state)
    got = store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
    assert (got.next_offset, got.now_ts, got.counters) == (3, None, Counters(0, 0, 3))
    assert got.state == state


def test_checkpoint_params_are_sorted_by_key():
    params = checkpoint_params(SITE, 1, 2, Counters(), tricky_state())
    assert params["v_uuid"] == sorted(tricky_state().vehicles)
    assert params["s_uuid"] == ["S1", "S2", "S3"]


# --- рестарт: тот же поток через настоящий Postgres -----------------------------------------


def test_restart_from_postgres_is_exactly_once_and_byte_identical(store):
    cfg = line_site()
    stream = scenario(cfg)
    ref = Engine(cfg)
    ref_outputs = [ref.apply(r).outputs for r in stream]
    # точки разреза — сразу после сообщений, давших выходы: повтор такого сообщения обязан дать ноль записей
    produced = [k for k in range(1, len(stream)) if ref_outputs[k - 1]]
    decisions = [k for k in produced if any(o.topic == "decision.v1" for o in ref_outputs[k - 1])]
    cuts = sorted({*produced[:: max(1, len(produced) // 6)], decisions[0], decisions[-1]})
    first = Engine(cfg)
    done = 0
    for k in cuts:
        for r in stream[done:k]:
            first.apply(r)
        done = k
        own = store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
        assert store.checkpoint(SITE, own.epoch, k, Counters(k, 0, 0), first.state)
        restored = store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
        assert restored.next_offset == k and restored.state is not None
        assert restored.state == first.state
        engine = Engine(cfg, restored.state)
        assert engine.apply(stream[k - 1]).outputs == ()  # последнее учтённое не применяется второй раз
        assert [engine.apply(r).outputs for r in stream[k:]] == ref_outputs[k:]
        assert engine.state == ref.state


# --- версии логики и конфигурации -------------------------------------------------------------


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("logic_version", "cfg_hash", "reason"),
    [
        ("v-next", HASH, "logic_version_changed"),
        (LOGIC_VERSION, "0" * 64, "config_changed"),
        ("v-next", "0" * 64, "logic_version_changed"),
    ],
)
def test_version_mismatch_with_state_refuses_and_rolls_back(store, admin, logic_version, cfg_hash, reason):
    claim = store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
    assert store.checkpoint(SITE, claim.epoch, 5, Counters(5, 0, 0), copy.deepcopy(tricky_state()))
    before = tables(admin)
    with pytest.raises(StartRefused) as refused:
        store.claim(SITE, logic_version, cfg_hash)
    assert refused.value.reason == reason and refused.value.hint == "make reset"
    assert tables(admin) == before  # epoch не увеличен: транзакция откачена
    assert store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH).epoch == claim.epoch + 1


def test_version_mismatch_with_empty_state_is_accepted_and_updated(store, admin):
    first = store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
    second = store.claim(SITE, "v-next", "0" * 64)
    assert second.epoch == first.epoch + 1 and second.state is None
    row = admin.execute("SELECT logic_version, config_hash FROM processor WHERE site_id = %s", (SITE,)).fetchone()
    assert row == ("v-next", "0" * 64)


def test_state_of_another_site_refuses_and_rolls_back(store, admin):
    """Смена [site] id без make reset (§2.5): в базе состояние другой площадки — отказ config_changed.

    В stations и vehicles нет site_id, и claim новой площадки иначе загрузил бы чужие станции и машины.
    """
    claim = store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
    assert store.checkpoint(SITE, claim.epoch, 5, Counters(5, 0, 0), tricky_state())
    before = tables(admin)
    with pytest.raises(StartRefused) as refused:
        store.claim("site-2", LOGIC_VERSION, "0" * 64)
    assert refused.value.reason == "config_changed" and SITE in refused.value.detail
    assert refused.value.hint == "make reset"
    assert tables(admin) == before  # строка site-2 не создана: транзакция откачена
    assert store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH).epoch == claim.epoch + 1  # своя площадка работает дальше


def test_other_site_claimed_without_checkpoint_also_refuses(store, admin):
    """Экземпляр другой площадки уже забрал базу, но ещё ничего не записал: он может записать в любой момент."""
    store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
    before = tables(admin)
    with pytest.raises(StartRefused) as refused:
        store.claim("site-2", LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
    assert refused.value.reason == "config_changed"
    assert tables(admin) == before


def test_state_rows_without_processor_offset_refuse(store, admin):
    """Строки stations/vehicles при пустом next_offset — состояние неизвестного происхождения: отказ, а не загрузка."""
    claim = store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
    assert store.checkpoint(SITE, claim.epoch, 5, Counters(5, 0, 0), tricky_state())
    admin.execute("DELETE FROM processor")
    before = tables(admin)
    with pytest.raises(StartRefused) as refused:
        store.claim(SITE, LOGIC_VERSION, HASH)
    assert refused.value.reason == "config_changed"
    assert tables(admin) == before


# --- сторож: замёрзший Postgres ------------------------------------------------------------------

# Процессор с настоящим PgStore в отдельном процессе: сторож завершает процесс через os._exit, как в проде.
STALL_CHILD = """
import sys
from tests.dispatcher_helpers import FakeSink, batch, example
from tests.helpers import two_stations
from vq.dispatcher import loop
from vq.dispatcher.store import PgStore
from vq.logs import setup_logging

setup_logging()  # site, epoch и offset строки выхода — из контекста процессора
cfg = two_stations()
deadline = loop.Deadline(float(sys.argv[2]))  # в проде 15 с; выход — настоящий os._exit(1)
p = loop.Processor(cfg, "cfg-hash", PgStore(sys.argv[1]), FakeSink([]), deadline=deadline)
p.on_assign(0, 100)
print("ready", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
sys.stdin.readline()
p.handle_batch(batch(example(cfg), 0))
print("returned", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
"""


def test_frozen_postgres_exits_1_within_deadline(pg, dsn, store):
    """§2.4 «exit(1) при таймауте Postgres» — и когда сервер заморожен (docker pause).

    statement_timeout исполняет сам сервер, а TCP-сегменты за замёрзший процесс подтверждает ядро: без сторожа
    чекпоинт висел бы до разморозки, heartbeat librdkafka держал бы партицию, а /metrics отвечал бы.
    """
    deadline_s = 1.0
    child = subprocess.Popen(
        [sys.executable, "-c", STALL_CHILD, dsn, str(deadline_s)],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
        cwd=ROOT,
    )
    assert child.stdin is not None and child.stderr is not None
    assert child.stderr.readline().strip() == "ready"
    cid = pg.get_wrapped_container().id
    subprocess.run(["docker", "pause", cid], check=True, capture_output=True)
    try:
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        child.stdin.write("go\n")
        child.stdin.flush()
        try:
            code: int | None = child.wait(timeout=deadline_s + 9)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            child.kill()
            code = None
        took = time.monotonic() - t0
    finally:
        subprocess.run(["docker", "unpause", cid], check=True, capture_output=True)
    out, err = child.communicate(timeout=10)
    assert code == 1, f"процесс не вышел за {took:.1f} с (код {code}); stderr: {err[-500:]}"
    assert took < deadline_s + 2
    last = json.loads(out.strip().splitlines()[-1])
    assert {k: last[k] for k in ("event", "level", "op", "site", "epoch", "offset", "next_offset")} == {
        "event": "exit_postgres_stalled",
        "level": "ERROR",
        "op": "checkpoint",
        "site": "test",
        "epoch": 1,
        "offset": 0,
        "next_offset": 5,
    }
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Общий JSON-лог сервисов**

`vq.logs` — формат логов всех трёх сервисов (§2.4 «Логи», §4.4, §5.1): `JsonFormatter` пишет одну строку строгого JSON на запись, ключи по порядку `ts` (UTC, миллисекунды, `Z`), `level`, `logger`, `event`, затем `defaults` (у dispatcher — `site`, `epoch`, `offset`) и поля события из `extra={"fields": {...}}`, трассировку — последним полем `error`. `describe` даёт короткий текст ошибки для полей `error`, `setup_logging` ставит форматтер на корневой логгер и возвращает его, чтобы сервис задавал `defaults`.

Create `src/vq/logs.py`:
```python
"""JSON-логи сервисов (§2.4): одна строка JSON на запись, в stdout. Общие для dispatcher, генератора и витрины."""

import json
import logging
import sys
from collections.abc import Mapping
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


def describe(e: BaseException) -> str:
    """Короткий текст ошибки: 'Тип: первая строка сообщения', не длиннее 200 символов; без сообщения — тип."""
    lines = str(e).strip().splitlines()
    return f"{type(e).__name__}: {lines[0]}"[:200] if lines else type(e).__name__


class JsonFormatter(logging.Formatter):
    """Ключи строки по порядку: ts (UTC, миллисекунды, Z), level, logger, event, поля, error.

    Поля события передаются как extra={"fields": {...}} (имена не спорят с атрибутами LogRecord), event — текст
    сообщения. У записи без fields (uvicorn, librdkafka) event = "log", текст — в msg. defaults — поля каждой
    строки (у dispatcher — site, epoch, offset): поля записи меняют их значение, но не место. error — трассировка,
    если запись несёт исключение. Значение, которое JSON не умеет (объект, NaN, ключ-кортеж), пишется текстом.
    """

    def __init__(self, defaults: Mapping[str, object] | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.defaults: Mapping[str, object] = dict(defaults or {})

    def format(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> str:
        fields = getattr(record, "fields", None)
        body: dict[Any, object] = dict(self.defaults)
        if isinstance(fields, Mapping):
            event = record.getMessage()
            body.update(fields)
        else:
            event = "log"
            body["msg"] = record.getMessage()
        doc: dict[Any, object] = {
            "ts": _utc(record.created),
            "level": record.levelname,
            "logger": record.name,
            "event": event,
        }
        for key, value in body.items():
            doc.setdefault(key, value)  # голову строки поля не перекрывают
        if record.exc_info:
            doc.pop("error", None)  # трассировка полнее текста ошибки и стоит последней
            doc["error"] = self.formatException(record.exc_info)
        try:
            return _dumps(doc)
        except Exception:  # NaN, ключ не строка, цикл, сломанный __str__: такое значение — текстом
            return _dumps({k if isinstance(k, str) else _text(k): _jsonable(v) for k, v in doc.items()})


def _utc(created: float) -> str:
    """Момент записи в UTC с миллисекундами: '2026-09-15T12:00:00.250Z'."""
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(created, UTC).replace(tzinfo=None).isoformat(timespec="milliseconds") + "Z"


def _dumps(obj: object) -> str:
    """Строгий JSON (без NaN и Infinity) в одну строку; неизвестный тип — через str()."""
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, default=str)


def _jsonable(value: object) -> object:
    """Значение, которое _dumps примет: само значение или его текст."""
    try:
        _dumps(value)
    except Exception:
        return _text(value)
    return value


def _text(value: object) -> str:
    """str(value); если __str__ сломан — repr object, он не бросает."""
    try:
        return str(value)
    except Exception:
        return object.__repr__(value)


def setup_logging(level: int = logging.INFO) -> JsonFormatter:
    """JsonFormatter в stdout на корневом логгере; возвращает его, через него сервис задаёт defaults.

    Повторный вызов второй обработчик не ставит: меняет только уровень и возвращает уже установленный форматтер.
    """
    root = logging.getLogger()
    root.setLevel(level)
    for installed in root.handlers:
        if isinstance(installed.formatter, JsonFormatter):
            return installed.formatter
    formatter = JsonFormatter()
    handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
    handler.setFormatter(formatter)
    root.addHandler(handler)
    return formatter
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Процесс vq-dispatcher**

Kafka-обвязка вокруг `Processor` задачи 6 (§2.4): настройки consumer (static membership, `auto.offset.reset=error`, range) и идемпотентного producer; `KafkaSink` ставит каждой записи заголовок `src_headers` (§2.3) и запоминает первую ошибку доставки; старт — `site.toml` и `config_hash`, ожидание Postgres до 60 с (`waiting_for_postgres`, §2.4 «Старт»), миграция под сторожем, `/metrics`, клиенты, проверка одной партиции `telemetry.v1` (§2.3), подписка. Колбэк назначения делает `claim` и `assign` с явным offset, потеря партиции выбрасывает ядро; цикл берёт до 500 сообщений за 0,25 с, переставляет чтение после отброшенной пачки, делает асинхронный `commit` только ради лага в Console и пишет `vq_consumer_lag_messages`. Ошибки — crash-only (§2.4 «Ошибки»): SIGTERM → 0, сбой → 1 со строкой `exit_fenced | exit_delivery_failed | exit_postgres | exit_kafka_fatal | exit_crash`, отказ старта → 2 со строкой `start_refused` и подсказкой `make reset`; перед выходом закрываются consumer и store.

Create `src/vq/dispatcher/main.py`:
```python
"""vq-dispatcher (§2.4): Kafka-клиенты и группа, цикл пачек, метрики, JSON-логи; crash-only."""

import logging
import os
import signal
import sys
import threading
import time
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from types import FrameType
from typing import Any

import psycopg
from confluent_kafka import Consumer, KafkaError, KafkaException, Message, Producer, TopicPartition
from prometheus_client import start_http_server

from vq.config import config_hash, load_config
from vq.core.codec import src_headers
from vq.dispatcher.loop import (
    EXIT_FAILURE,
    EXIT_OK,
    EXIT_REFUSED,
    Deadline,
    DeliveryFailed,
    Fenced,
    InMsg,
    Processor,
    chaos_hook,
    log,
)
from vq.dispatcher.metrics import DispatcherMetrics
from vq.dispatcher.store import MIGRATIONS_DIR, PgStore, StartRefused
from vq.logs import JsonFormatter, describe, setup_logging

TELEMETRY_TOPIC = "telemetry.v1"
DEFAULT_KAFKA = "localhost:19092"
DEFAULT_PG_DSN = "postgresql://vq:vq@localhost:5432/vq"
DEFAULT_CONFIG = "config/site.toml"
DEFAULT_METRICS_PORT = 9100
BATCH_SIZE = 500
POLL_TIMEOUT_S = 0.25
WATERMARK_TIMEOUT_S = 5.0
METADATA_TIMEOUT_S = 10.0
SHUTDOWN_FLUSH_S = 10.0
PG_WAIT_S = 60.0  # сколько старт ждёт недоступный Postgres, прежде чем выйти с кодом 1
PG_RETRY_S = 1.0

INFO_ERRORS = frozenset({KafkaError._TRANSPORT, KafkaError._ALL_BROKERS_DOWN, KafkaError._PARTITION_EOF})


class KafkaFatal(Exception):
    """Фатальная ошибка клиента Kafka: consumer — ошибка consume() с кодом _FATAL, producer — error_cb с fatal()."""


# Сбой → событие строки выхода с кодом 1 (§2.4), первое совпадение. StartRefused — код 2, прочее — exit_crash.
FAILURES: tuple[tuple[type[Exception], str], ...] = (
    (Fenced, "exit_fenced"),
    (DeliveryFailed, "exit_delivery_failed"),
    (psycopg.Error, "exit_postgres"),
    (KafkaFatal, "exit_kafka_fatal"),
)


# --- настройки и чистые проверки ---------------------------------------------


def consumer_config(bootstrap: str, site_id: str, instance_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Настройки consumer строго по §2.4. instance_id — только для standby (dispatcher-b), иначе dispatcher-<site>."""
    return {
        "bootstrap.servers": bootstrap,
        "group.id": "dispatcher",
        "group.instance.id": instance_id or f"dispatcher-{site_id}",
        "session.timeout.ms": 10000,
        "heartbeat.interval.ms": 3000,
        "enable.auto.commit": False,
        "auto.offset.reset": "error",
        "group.protocol": "classic",
        "partition.assignment.strategy": "range",
    }


def producer_config(bootstrap: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Настройки producer строго по §2.4."""
    return {
        "bootstrap.servers": bootstrap,
        "enable.idempotence": True,
        "acks": "all",
        "linger.ms": 5,
        "compression.type": "zstd",
        "message.timeout.ms": 30000,
    }


def check_single_partition(topic: str, partitions: int | None) -> None:
    """У входного топика ровно одна партиция — иначе нет единого порядка (§2.3, §2.7). None — топика нет."""
    if partitions is None:
        raise StartRefused("partitions", f"топика {topic} нет")
    if partitions != 1:
        raise StartRefused("partitions", f"у {topic} {partitions} партиций, нужна ровно одна")


def classify_error(err: KafkaError) -> str:
    """Что делать с ошибкой из consume(): fatal | offset_reset | info | other.

    Фатальную ошибку consumer (например, FENCED_INSTANCE_ID) librdkafka отдаёт из consume() с кодом _FATAL,
    а confluent-kafka строит такой KafkaError с fatal() == False: проверяется и флаг, и код.
    """
    if err.fatal() or err.code() == KafkaError._FATAL:
        return "fatal"
    if err.code() == KafkaError._AUTO_OFFSET_RESET:
        return "offset_reset"
    if err.code() in INFO_ERRORS:
        return "info"
    return "other"


def offset_reset_reason(expected: int | None, low: int, high: int) -> str:
    """Причина отказа при ERR__AUTO_OFFSET_RESET: offset позади лога или лог создан заново."""
    if expected is not None and expected > high >= 0:
        return "log_recreated"
    return "state_older_than_log"


# --- Kafka -------------------------------------------------------------------


class KafkaSink:
    """Sink поверх confluent_kafka.Producer: заголовок vq-src-offset, первая ошибка доставки — в failed."""

    def __init__(self, producer: Any) -> None:
        self._producer = producer
        self.failed: str | None = None

    def on_delivery(self, err: KafkaError | None, msg: Message) -> None:
        if err is not None and self.failed is None:
            self.failed = f"{msg.topic()}: {err.str()}"

    def send(self, topic: str, key: bytes, value: bytes, src_offset: int) -> None:
        headers = src_headers(src_offset)
        while True:
            try:
                self._producer.produce(topic, value=value, key=key, headers=headers, on_delivery=self.on_delivery)
                break
            except BufferError:  # локальная очередь полна: обслужить отчёты о доставке и повторить
                self._producer.poll(0.1)
        self._producer.poll(0)

    def flush(self, timeout: float) -> int:
        return int(self._producer.flush(timeout))


def partition_count(consumer: Consumer, topic: str) -> int | None:
    md = consumer.list_topics(topic, timeout=METADATA_TIMEOUT_S)
    t = md.topics.get(topic)
    if t is None:
        return None
    if t.error is not None:
        if t.error.code() == KafkaError.UNKNOWN_TOPIC_OR_PART:
            return None
        raise KafkaException(t.error)
    return len(t.partitions)


# --- логи ----------------------------------------------------------------------


def log_defaults(site: str | None) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Поля §2.4 в каждой строке лога: site площадки; epoch и offset задают строки процессора, у прочих — null."""
    return {"site": site, "epoch": None, "offset": None}


def _event(level: int, event: str, processor: Processor | None = None, **fields: object) -> None:
    if processor is not None:
        processor.log(level, event, **fields)
    else:
        log.log(level, event, extra={"fields": fields})


def on_kafka_error(err: KafkaError, processor: Processor | None) -> None:
    """error_cb обоих клиентов: ошибка — в лог; фатальная — KafkaFatal (выход 1, §2.4).

    Исключение из error_cb confluent-kafka пробрасывает из вызова, который обслуживал колбэк (poll, flush,
    consume). Фатальные ошибки сюда приносит producer; фатальную ошибку consumer ловит classify_error.
    """
    fatal = err.fatal()
    _event(
        logging.ERROR if fatal else logging.WARNING,
        "kafka_error",
        processor,
        code=err.name(),
        error=err.str(),
        fatal=fatal,
    )
    if fatal:
        raise KafkaFatal(err.str())


# --- цикл ----------------------------------------------------------------------


def _handle_error(err: KafkaError, consumer: Consumer, processor: Processor) -> None:
    kind = classify_error(err)
    if kind == "fatal":
        raise KafkaFatal(err.str())
    if kind == "offset_reset":
        expected = processor.expected
        try:
            low, high = consumer.get_watermark_offsets(
                TopicPartition(TELEMETRY_TOPIC, 0), timeout=WATERMARK_TIMEOUT_S, cached=False
            )
        except KafkaException:
            low, high = -1, -1
        raise StartRefused(offset_reset_reason(expected, low, high), f"{err.str()}; watermarks [{low}, {high}]")
    level = logging.INFO if kind == "info" else logging.WARNING
    processor.log(level, "kafka_error", code=err.name(), error=err.str())


def consume_loop(consumer: Consumer, processor: Processor, metrics: DispatcherMetrics, stop: threading.Event) -> None:
    tp = TopicPartition(TELEMETRY_TOPIC, 0)
    while not stop.is_set():
        batch: list[InMsg] = []
        for m in consumer.consume(num_messages=BATCH_SIZE, timeout=POLL_TIMEOUT_S):
            err = m.error()
            if err is not None:
                _handle_error(err, consumer, processor)
                continue
            offset = m.offset()
            if offset is not None:
                batch.append(InMsg(offset, m.value()))
        if not batch:
            continue
        seek_to = processor.handle_batch(batch)
        if seek_to is not None:
            consumer.seek(TopicPartition(TELEMETRY_TOPIC, 0, seek_to))
            continue
        nxt = processor.expected
        if not processor.assigned or nxt is None:  # партиции нет
            continue
        try:  # commit — только для лага в Console и метриках; источник правды — Postgres
            consumer.commit(offsets=[TopicPartition(TELEMETRY_TOPIC, 0, nxt)], asynchronous=True)
        except KafkaException as e:
            processor.log(logging.WARNING, "commit_failed", error=str(e))
        try:
            _, high = consumer.get_watermark_offsets(tp, cached=True)
        except KafkaException:
            continue
        if high >= 0:
            metrics.observe_lag(high - nxt)


# --- старт и выход ---------------------------------------------------------------


def open_store(dsn: str, migrations: Path, stop: threading.Event) -> PgStore | None:
    """Подключиться к Postgres, ожидая его до PG_WAIT_S (§2.6); None — SIGTERM во время ожидания.

    Без ожидания старт при недоступном Postgres выходит за доли секунды, Docker удваивает паузу перед следующим
    рестартом (до 60 с), и после возврата Postgres площадка ждала бы очередного рестарта. В памяти ещё ничего нет,
    поэтому ожидание остаётся crash-only.
    """
    give_up = time.monotonic() + PG_WAIT_S
    attempt = 0
    while True:
        try:
            return PgStore(dsn, migrations_dir=migrations)
        except psycopg.OperationalError as e:
            attempt += 1
            if time.monotonic() >= give_up:
                raise
            _event(logging.WARNING, "waiting_for_postgres", attempt=attempt, error=describe(e))
        if stop.wait(PG_RETRY_S):
            return None


def subscribe(consumer: Consumer, proc: Processor) -> None:
    """Подписка с колбэками группы (§2.4): назначение — claim и assign с явным offset, потеря — сброс ядра."""

    def on_assign(c: Consumer, partitions: list[TopicPartition]) -> None:
        if not partitions:  # в группе больше участников, чем партиций
            return
        low, high = c.get_watermark_offsets(
            TopicPartition(TELEMETRY_TOPIC, 0), timeout=WATERMARK_TIMEOUT_S, cached=False
        )
        offset = proc.on_assign(low, high)
        # клиент не берёт offset из изменённого списка partitions: назначаем явно
        c.assign([TopicPartition(TELEMETRY_TOPIC, 0, offset)])

    def on_revoke(c: Consumer, partitions: list[TopicPartition]) -> None:
        proc.on_revoke("revoke")

    def on_lost(c: Consumer, partitions: list[TopicPartition]) -> None:
        proc.on_revoke("lost")

    consumer.subscribe([TELEMETRY_TOPIC], on_assign=on_assign, on_revoke=on_revoke, on_lost=on_lost)


@dataclass
class Opened:
    """Что успел открыть старт: run() закрывает это при любом выходе."""

    store: PgStore | None = None
    consumer: Consumer | None = None
    processor: Processor | None = None

    def close(self) -> None:
        """Перед выходом 1 тоже вызывается consumer.close() (§2.4); ошибка закрытия — только строка лога."""
        if self.consumer is not None:
            try:
                self.consumer.close()
            except Exception as e:
                _event(logging.WARNING, "consumer_close_failed", self.processor, error=describe(e))
        if self.store is not None:
            try:
                self.store.close()
            except Exception as e:
                _event(logging.WARNING, "store_close_failed", self.processor, error=describe(e))


def serve(env: Mapping[str, str], formatter: JsonFormatter, stop: threading.Event, opened: Opened) -> int:
    """Старт по §2.4 и цикл до SIGTERM; всё открытое — в opened."""
    cfg_path = env.get("VQ_CONFIG", DEFAULT_CONFIG)
    cfg = load_config(cfg_path)
    chash = config_hash(cfg_path)
    formatter.defaults = log_defaults(cfg.site_id)
    bootstrap = env.get("VQ_KAFKA", DEFAULT_KAFKA)
    migrations = Path(env.get("VQ_MIGRATIONS") or MIGRATIONS_DIR)
    store = opened.store = open_store(env.get("VQ_PG_DSN", DEFAULT_PG_DSN), migrations, stop)
    if store is None:  # SIGTERM, пока ждали Postgres
        return EXIT_OK
    deadline = Deadline()
    with deadline.guard("migrate", {}):
        store.migrate()
    metrics = DispatcherMetrics(stations=[s.uuid for s in cfg.stations])
    start_http_server(int(env.get("VQ_METRICS_PORT") or DEFAULT_METRICS_PORT))

    def on_error(err: KafkaError) -> None:
        on_kafka_error(err, opened.processor)

    common = {"error_cb": on_error, "logger": logging.getLogger("vq.kafka")}
    sink = KafkaSink(Producer({**producer_config(bootstrap), **common}))
    crash = chaos_hook(env.get("VQ_CRASH_FILE"))
    proc = opened.processor = Processor(cfg, chash, store, sink, metrics, crash, deadline)
    consumer_cfg = consumer_config(bootstrap, cfg.site_id, env.get("VQ_GROUP_INSTANCE_ID"))
    consumer = opened.consumer = Consumer({**consumer_cfg, **common})
    check_single_partition(TELEMETRY_TOPIC, partition_count(consumer, TELEMETRY_TOPIC))
    subscribe(consumer, proc)
    _event(logging.INFO, "start", proc, config=cfg_path, config_hash=chash, kafka=bootstrap)
    consume_loop(consumer, proc, metrics, stop)
    _event(logging.INFO, "stop", proc)
    opened.consumer = None
    consumer.close()
    left = sink.flush(SHUTDOWN_FLUSH_S)
    if left:
        _event(logging.WARNING, "shutdown_unflushed", proc, messages=left)
    return EXIT_OK


def exit_line(e: Exception, processor: Processor | None) -> int:
    """Строка выхода и код (§2.4): отказ старта — 2 с причиной и подсказкой, любой сбой — 1."""
    if isinstance(e, StartRefused):
        _event(logging.ERROR, "start_refused", processor, reason=e.reason, detail=e.detail, hint=e.hint)
        return EXIT_REFUSED
    event = next((ev for kind, ev in FAILURES if isinstance(e, kind)), None)
    if event is None:  # в том числе исключение ядра: со стеком
        log.error("exit_crash", exc_info=e, extra={"fields": {} if processor is None else processor.context()})
    else:
        _event(logging.ERROR, event, processor, error=describe(e))
    return EXIT_FAILURE


def run(env: Mapping[str, str], formatter: JsonFormatter, stop: threading.Event) -> int:
    """Код выхода: 0 — SIGTERM, 1 — сбой (crash-only: контейнер перезапустится), 2 — отказ старта (make reset)."""
    formatter.defaults = log_defaults(None)  # site — после чтения site.toml (serve)
    opened = Opened()
    try:
        return serve(env, formatter, stop, opened)
    except Exception as e:
        return exit_line(e, opened.processor)
    finally:
        opened.close()


def main() -> None:
    formatter = setup_logging()
    stop = threading.Event()

    def on_signal(signum: int, frame: FrameType | None) -> None:
        stop.set()

    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, on_signal)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, on_signal)
    code = run(os.environ, formatter, stop)
    logging.shutdown()
    sys.exit(code)
```

### Task 8: Генератор на Kafka

Всё, кроме клиентов confluent-kafka, проверяется тестами на подделках; клиенты создаются в `main()` и передаются в `run()` фабриками.

Тесты процесса генератора без Kafka (§4.3–§4.6, §6.1): аргументы и умолчания (`--speed max` только с `--no-decisions`, иначе код 2); темп без накопления ошибки; часы старта (`--allow-dirty` — наибольший `ts` хвоста + 1, а не последняя запись); отказ на непустом `telemetry.v1` и предупреждение `dirty_start`; порядок «решения → тик → сбои»; досылка и `flush` в конце, по SIGTERM и после исключения; итог `summary.json` и коды выхода; идемпотентный продюсер с повтором при `BufferError`; лента `decision.v1` — с high watermark до первого тика и без удержания записей; метрики §4.6; JSON-строки лога в stdout.

Create `tests/test_generator_main.py`:
```python
"""Процесс генератора без Kafka: аргументы, темп, часы старта, итог, порядок цикла, продюсер, поток решений и сборка
run() на подделках клиентов."""

import argparse
import json
import logging
import os
import signal
import threading
import time
from collections import Counter
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest
from prometheus_client import CollectorRegistry

from tests.helpers import two_stations
from vq.config import load_config
from vq.core.codec import Telemetry, encode_telemetry
from vq.generator import main as gm
from vq.generator.metrics import GeneratorMetrics
from vq.generator.sim import DecisionStats, Sim

T0 = 1_789_473_600  # 2026-09-15T12:00:00Z
UNITS = ("T-01", "T-02")
SITE_TOML = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "config" / "site.toml"
POISON = b"[" * 100_000  # json.loads падает с RecursionError, а не ValueError
# at не в каноническом виде fmt_ts (месяц одной цифрой): strptime такое принимает, parse_ts — нет
NON_CANONICAL_AT = b'{"unit_uuid":"T1","at":"2026-9-15T12:00:00Z","result":"rejected","reason":"no_gain"}'


def rejected(unit: str) -> bytes:
    return f'{{"unit_uuid":"{unit}","at":"2026-09-15T12:00:00Z","result":"rejected","reason":"no_gain"}}'.encode()


def tel(unit: str, ts: int, speed: float = 36.0) -> Telemetry:
    return Telemetry(unit, ts, 49.2, 142.66, speed)


# --- подделки -------------------------------------------------------------


class FakeSim:
    """Каждый тик — по сообщению на машину; журнал вызовов для проверки порядка.

    hook(k) вызывается в начале тика k (сбой, сигнал, ожидание).
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        start_ts: int,
        clock: "FakeClock | None" = None,
        tick_cost: float = 0.0,
        journal: list | None = None,
        hook: Callable[[int], None] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.t = start_ts
        self.stats = DecisionStats()
        self.journal: list[tuple] = [] if journal is None else journal
        self._clock = clock
        self._cost = tick_cost
        self._hook = hook
        self._k = 0

    def offer_decision(self, raw: bytes) -> None:
        self.journal.append(("offer", raw))
        self.stats.received += 1

    def tick(self) -> list[Telemetry]:
        if self._hook is not None:
            self._hook(self._k)
        self._k += 1
        self.journal.append(("tick", self.t))
        if self._clock is not None:
            self._clock.t += self._cost
        out = [tel(u, self.t) for u in UNITS]
        self.t += 1
        return out


class HookedSim(Sim):
    """Настоящий симулятор; hook(k) вызывается в начале тика k."""

    def __init__(self, cfg, seed: int, start_ts: int, hook: Callable[[int], None]) -> None:
        super().__init__(cfg, seed, start_ts)
        self._hook = hook
        self._k = 0

    def tick(self) -> list[Telemetry]:
        self._hook(self._k)
        self._k += 1
        return super().tick()


class FakeInjector:
    """Каждое сообщение T-01 дублируется в конце прогона; drain отдаёт дубли."""

    def __init__(self, drain_error: Exception | None = None) -> None:
        self.faults: Counter = Counter()
        self.expected_drops = 0
        self.pushed: list[tuple[int, list[str]]] = []
        self._deferred: list[Telemetry] = []
        self._drain_error = drain_error

    def push(self, t: int, msgs: list[Telemetry]) -> list[Telemetry]:
        self.pushed.append((t, [m.unit_uuid for m in msgs]))
        for m in msgs:
            if m.unit_uuid == "T-01":
                self._deferred.append(m)
                self.faults["dup"] += 1
        return list(msgs)

    def drain(self) -> list[Telemetry]:
        if self._drain_error is not None:
            raise self._drain_error
        out, self._deferred = self._deferred, []
        self.expected_drops += len(out)
        return out


class FakeSink:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.sent: list[Telemetry] = []
        self.polls = 0
        self.flushes: list[float] = []
        self.fatal: str | None = None

    @property
    def produced(self) -> int:
        return len(self.sent)

    def send(self, msg: Telemetry) -> None:
        self.sent.append(msg)

    def poll(self) -> None:
        self.polls += 1

    def flush(self, timeout: float) -> int:
        self.flushes.append(timeout)
        return 0


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, t: float = 1000.0) -> None:
        self.t = t
        self.sleeps: list[float] = []

    def __call__(self) -> float:
        return self.t

    def sleep(self, d: float) -> None:
        self.sleeps.append(d)
        self.t += d

    assert (a.dup_rate, a.late_rate, a.outage_rate) == (0.005, 0.002, 0.0005)
    assert a.summary == Path("/out/summary.json")
    assert not a.no_decisions and not a.allow_dirty

# --- темп ------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_pacer_schedule():
    p = gm.Pacer(start_wall=100.0, speed=20.0)
    assert p.due(0) == 100.0
    assert p.due(20) == pytest.approx(101.0)
    assert p.due(1_000_000) == pytest.approx(100.0 + 50_000.0)  # без накопления ошибки


def test_pacer_max_never_waits():
    p = gm.Pacer(start_wall=100.0, speed=None)
    assert p.due(5) is None


def test_ticks_follow_schedule_without_drift():
    """Тик k уходит в start + k / N, сколько бы ни длился сам тик (пока он короче интервала)."""
    clock = FakeClock()
    sim = FakeSim(T0, clock=clock, tick_cost=0.3)
    times: list[float] = []
    gm.run_loop(
        sim,
        FakeInjector(),
        FakeSink(),
        gm.Pacer(clock(), 2.0),
        duration=5,
        stop=gm.StopFlag(),
        on_tick=lambda k, t: times.append(clock() - 0.3),  # момент начала тика
        clock=clock,
        sleep=clock.sleep,
    )
    assert times == pytest.approx([1000.0, 1000.5, 1001.0, 1001.5, 1002.0])
    assert max(clock.sleeps) <= 0.1 + 1e-9  # короткие паузы: сигнал не ждёт конца секунды


def test_max_speed_never_sleeps():
    clock = FakeClock()
    gm.run_loop(
        FakeSim(T0),
        FakeInjector(),
        FakeSink(),
        gm.Pacer(clock(), None),
        duration=50,
        stop=gm.StopFlag(),
        clock=clock,
        sleep=clock.sleep,
    )
    assert clock.sleeps == []


# --- основной цикл ----------------------------------------------------------


def test_loop_order_decisions_before_tick_and_push_with_tick_ts():
    clock = FakeClock()
    sim, inj, sink = FakeSim(T0), FakeInjector(), FakeSink()
    batches = iter([[], [b"d1", b"d2"], [], [b"d3"]])
    res = gm.run_loop(
        sim,
        inj,
        sink,
        gm.Pacer(clock(), None),
        duration=4,
        stop=gm.StopFlag(),
        decisions=lambda: next(batches),
        clock=clock,
        sleep=clock.sleep,
    )
    assert res.ticks == 4 and res.last_ts == T0 + 3
    assert sim.journal == [
        ("tick", T0),
        ("offer", b"d1"),
        ("offer", b"d2"),
        ("tick", T0 + 1),
        ("tick", T0 + 2),
        ("offer", b"d3"),
        ("tick", T0 + 3),
    ]
    assert inj.pushed == [(T0 + k, list(UNITS)) for k in range(4)]  # t — ts тика, сообщения тика по порядку
    assert [m.ts for m in sink.sent] == [T0, T0, T0 + 1, T0 + 1, T0 + 2, T0 + 2, T0 + 3, T0 + 3]
    assert sink.polls == 4


def test_loop_goes_on_past_a_decision_the_real_sim_cannot_parse():
    """GM-3: цикл не ловит исключения решений — их нет. Настоящий Sim сам считает мусор (здесь — JSON глубже
    предела рекурсии) в ignored.invalid и не бросает (тест свойства — в test_generator.py)."""
    sim = Sim(load_config(SITE_TOML), 1, T0)
    batches = iter([[rejected("T-01")], [POISON]])
    clock = FakeClock()
    res = gm.run_loop(
        sim,
        FakeInjector(),
        FakeSink(),
        gm.Pacer(clock(), None),

class FakeProducer:
    def __init__(self, conf: dict, full_times: int = 0) -> None:
        self.conf = conf
        self.full_times = full_times
        self.produced: list[tuple] = []
        self.polls: list[float] = []

    def produce(self, topic, key=None, value=None, on_delivery=None):
        if self.full_times > 0:
            self.full_times -= 1
            raise BufferError("Local: Queue full")
        self.produced.append((topic, key, value, on_delivery))

    def poll(self, timeout: float) -> int:
        self.polls.append(timeout)
        return 0

    def flush(self, timeout: float) -> int:
        return 0

def test_sink_counts_delivery_failures_and_fatal_errors():
    producer = FakeProducer({})
    sink = gm.KafkaSink(lambda conf: producer, {})
    sink.send(tel("T-01", T0))
    sink.send(tel("T-02", T0))
    reports = [cb for *_, cb in producer.produced]  # отчёты о доставке librdkafka вызывает из poll и flush
    reports[0](None, None)
    reports[1]("Local: Message timed out", None)
    assert (sink.delivered, sink.delivery_failed, sink.last_delivery_error) == (1, 1, "Local: Message timed out")

    class Err:
        def __init__(self, fatal: bool) -> None:
            self._fatal = fatal

        def fatal(self) -> bool:
            return self._fatal

        def __str__(self) -> str:
            return "boom"

    sink.on_error(Err(False))
    assert sink.fatal is None
    sink.on_error(Err(True))
    assert sink.fatal == "boom"


# --- поток решений и проверка топика ----------------------------------------------------


class FakeMsg:
    def __init__(self, value, offset=0, error=None):
        self._value, self._offset, self._error = value, offset, error

    def value(self):
        return self._value

    def offset(self):
        return self._offset

    def error(self):
        return self._error


class FakeConsumer:
    def __init__(self, low: int = 0, high: int = 0, batches=None) -> None:
        self.low, self.high = low, high
        self.batches = list(batches or [])
        self.assigned: list = []
        self.closed = False
        self.unassigned = False

    def get_watermark_offsets(self, tp, timeout=None, cached=False):
        return self.low, self.high

    def assign(self, parts):
        self.assigned.append([(p.topic, p.partition, p.offset) for p in parts])

    def unassign(self):
        self.unassigned = True

    def consume(self, num_messages=1, timeout=-1):
        if self.batches:
            return self.batches.pop(0)
        time.sleep(min(timeout, 0.01))
        return []

    def poll(self, timeout=-1):
        while self.batches and not self.batches[0]:
            self.batches.pop(0)
        if self.batches:
            return self.batches[0].pop(0)
        time.sleep(min(max(timeout, 0.0), 0.01))
        return None

    def close(self):
        self.closed = True


class BatchingConsumer:
    """Семантика librdkafka: consume(num_messages=N, timeout) ждёт N записей или весь таймаут; poll — первую."""

    def __init__(self, high: int = 0) -> None:
        self.high = high
        self.assigned: list = []
        self.closed = False
        self.waiting = threading.Event()  # поток решений уже ждёт внутри poll/consume
        self.held_back = 0  # вызовы, что держали готовую запись до таймаута в ожидании полной пачки
        self._msgs: list[FakeMsg] = []
        self._woken = False
        self._cond = threading.Condition()

    def get_watermark_offsets(self, tp, timeout=None, cached=False):
        return 0, self.high

    def assign(self, parts):
        self.assigned.append([(p.topic, p.partition, p.offset) for p in parts])

    def put(self, msg: FakeMsg) -> None:
        with self._cond:
            self._msgs.append(msg)
            self._cond.notify_all()

    def wake(self) -> None:
        with self._cond:
            self._woken = True
            self._cond.notify_all()

    def _take(self, n: int, timeout: float) -> list[FakeMsg]:
        with self._cond:
            self.waiting.set()
            self._cond.wait_for(lambda: len(self._msgs) >= n or self._woken, None if timeout < 0 else timeout)
            if 0 < len(self._msgs) < n and not self._woken:
                self.held_back += 1
            out, self._msgs = self._msgs[:n], self._msgs[n:]
            return out

    def poll(self, timeout=-1):
        got = self._take(1, timeout)
        return got[0] if got else None

    def consume(self, num_messages=1, timeout=-1):
        return self._take(num_messages, timeout)

    def close(self):
        self.closed = True
        self.wake()


def test_decision_feed_starts_at_high_watermark_and_queues_values():
    consumer = FakeConsumer(
        low=0, high=17, batches=[[FakeMsg(b"a", 17), FakeMsg(None, 18), FakeMsg(b"x", 19, "err")], [FakeMsg(b"b", 20)]]
    )
    feed = gm.DecisionFeed(consumer)
    assert feed.start() == 17
    assert consumer.assigned == [[("decision.v1", 0, 17)]]
    got: list[bytes] = []
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 2.0
    while len(got) < 2 and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        got += feed.drain()
        time.sleep(0.01)
    feed.stop()
    assert got == [b"a", b"b"]  # tombstone и ошибка пропущены
    assert consumer.closed


def test_decision_feed_hands_over_a_lone_record_without_waiting_for_a_batch():
    """GM-1, §4.3: одно решение уходит в drain(), не дожидаясь пачки.

    consume(num_messages=N, timeout) в librdkafka ждёт N записей или весь таймаут: при x20 каждая рекомендация
    запаздывала бы ещё на секунды симуляции сверх задержки самого dispatcher. held_back подделки считает вызовы,
    которые держали готовую запись до таймаута, — проверка по событию, а не по часам.
    """
    consumer = BatchingConsumer(high=5)
    feed = gm.DecisionFeed(consumer, poll_timeout=2.0)
    assert feed.start() == 5
    try:
        assert consumer.waiting.wait(1.0)  # поток уже ждёт внутри вызова — запись придёт в середине ожидания
        consumer.put(FakeMsg(b"d1", 5))
        sent = time.monotonic()
        got: list[bytes] = []
        while not got and time.monotonic() - sent < 5.0:
            got = feed.drain()
            time.sleep(0.001)
        latency = time.monotonic() - sent
    finally:
        consumer.wake()
        feed.stop()
    assert got == [b"d1"] and consumer.held_back == 0
    assert latency < 2.0  # меньше таймаута опроса: ожидание пачки держало бы запись все 2 с
    assert consumer.closed


class StuckConsumer(FakeConsumer):
    """poll не возвращается, пока тест не отпустит: поток решений завис внутри librdkafka."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__(high=3)
        self.entered = threading.Event()
        self.release = threading.Event()

    def poll(self, timeout=-1):
        self.entered.set()
        self.release.wait(10.0)
        return None


def test_decision_feed_stop_does_not_close_a_consumer_still_in_use(caplog):
    """close() рядом с poll() другого потока на том же клиенте — неопределённое поведение librdkafka (A4-18)."""
    consumer = StuckConsumer()
    feed = gm.DecisionFeed(consumer)
    feed.start()
    try:
        assert consumer.entered.wait(2.0)
        with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger="vq.generator"):
            feed.stop(timeout=0.05)
        assert not consumer.closed
        assert [r.getMessage() for r in caplog.records] == ["decisions_thread_alive"]
    finally:
        consumer.release.set()
```
